sections.heading: Mammootty — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mammootty was born on 6 September 1951 in Chandiroor, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Muhammad Kutty Ismail Panaparambil. He is a sibling of Ibrahim Kutty.
He received his education at Government Law College, Kozhikode and Sacred Heart College, Thevara.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi, Malayalam, Tamil and Kannada.
